name: safety-governance
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when trust-ladder / budget enforcement moves into a different layer than a project-local central config (config.json) consulted at tick entry, or when the config schema reaches its next breaking major (3.0.0).
spec_change_reason: Stop the spurious 'config field-merge conflict at schema_version' stderr warning. schema_version is loader-owned metadata (the GOVERNANCE_SCHEMA_VERSION stamp, not a user knob, gates nothing at runtime); _overlay already normalizes it to the current constant, but merge_config still ran over it and recorded a bogus conflict (user 2.7.0 vs shipped 2.2.0 vs base 2.8.0 all differ). load_config now strips schema_version from copies of the override (raw) and the shipped default (mine) before merge_config, so no spurious conflict is ever recorded. Pure noise fix, NO behavior change: the loaded schema_version was and remains GOVERNANCE_SCHEMA_VERSION, real knob conflicts (e.g. mode) still warn, and neither _overlay nor the shipped default-config/config.json (frozen 2.2.0) is touched. spec.md carried the exclusion paragraph (committed dfc9e37); this cycle implements the code+tests and re-anchors the housekeep doc-baseline floor 438->454 for the legitimate spec growth.
spec_no_change_reason: spec sub-bullet for issue_filter_apply_labels already committed in cb35896 (spec version 0.13.0) prior to this test-write cycle
